candidate_findings.subject: Varillas Chamber 2 multiple burial date associations
candidate_findings.evidence_status: evidence-examined (published table text; no lab recheck)
candidate_findings.statement: Radiocarbon samples linked to Varillas Chamber 2 Burials 2 (Beta-75377, 1020±90 BP; 865–1220 CE), 3 (Beta-75379, 520±60 BP; 1310–1360/1380–1470 CE), 5 (Beta-75380, 1030±80 BP; 875–1195 CE), and 6 (Beta-75381, 1220±60 BP; 670–970 CE) are not one closely coeval group. Sample materials and direct burial association require further checking.

candidate_findings.subject: Pirul differentiated funerary and reuse date contexts
candidate_findings.evidence_status: evidence-examined (published table text; no lab recheck)
candidate_findings.statement: Pirul excavation register distinguishes Beta-90279 (Burial 15; 1540±70 BP, 2σ 395–650 CE), Beta-90280 (Burials 24/25/27; 1270±50 BP, 2σ 665–885 CE), Beta-90282 (Burial 27; 1170±50 BP, 2σ 770–990 CE), and Beta-90284 (above AA228; 560±60 BP, 2σ 1295–1450 CE). Dates span different contexts; avoid merging into one phase.
